Dr. Manoj physiotherapy 
BPT (Bachelor of physiotherapy) 
Deals with the treatment of all musculoskeletal problems
with Physiotherapy which includes electrotherapy, exercise
therapy and manual therapy. This Physiotherapy clinic in
Moradabad provides services like diagnosis and treatment of
the following:-
Treatment available for
*Back Pain
*Slip Disc
*Sciatica
*Cervical Spondylitis
*Knee Pain
*Heel Pain
*Arthritis
*Frozen Shoulder
*Bell's Palsy
*Tennis Elbow
*Sports Injuries
*Muscle & Joint Pain
This channel provides healthy information related to physiotherapy or physical therapy and also about fitness exercises for weight loss
Dr.Manoj kumar
BPT, 
Consultant Physiotherapist
Rajrishi physiotherapy Chauraha Gali, Bartan Bazar, Moradabad 244001

for appointment-+919917050126
